about: English suffixes for the source folders (docs/plan.md, Decisions 2026-11-02: map code plus an English suffix). events: the two-letter folder of event/obj/<xx>/; battles: the letters a battle script's name starts with. Each name is the place the game's own location names (the save location of the area's events, macro dictionary section 11) give for that area; areas whose events name no single place (developer maps, the ending, the opening, scene*) keep the bare code. Hand-written; proper names only, no game data. scripts: a note on scripts the PC build does not load, or loads only behind a debug switch (from FFX.exe's file-name code and its map table eventid.bin); written at the top of each of their files and in AREAS.md.
